depth-8 chain verifies and authorizes; depth 9 refused at issuance (swarm cap) — and since wave-86 verify_delegation_chain ALSO re-checks the cap, a hand-forged deep chain dies at verification too (see depth_cap_verify_side)
hand-forged depth-9 chain (all signatures valid, issuance bypassed) refused at verification (DelegationAttenuationError); depth-8 control verifies
token expired 1h ago (+300s skew exhausted) refused at authorize time — per-action window re-check, not bind-time residue
token with not_before 2h in the future refused (window is [nbf - skew, exp + skew], two-sided)

agent-without-delegation fails closed on both mouths: no context at the executor gate, no token at bind
child signed by a non-parent rostered key refused: hop issuer must match the session roster key for the claimed parent
revocation seam holds: revoked leaf refused and a revoked parent invalidates the descendant chain
revocation is wired at the executor gate: revoked leaf refused, revoked ancestor refused for the child, raising checker fails closed as DelegationRevokedError
agent B's call with agent A's bound context refused (acting identity != delegation subject); agent A's own call passed the gate
spawn budget enforced: second spawn at budget=1 refused (SpawnBudgetExhaustedError); negative/bool/str budgets refused at construction

spawn from an unbound parent refused: spawn requires a BOUND parent DelegationContext
scope widening refused at issuance (spawn) and at chain verify (parent-signed widened child) — attenuation is monotonic-decreasing on both seams
scope tamper refused: signature covers the canonical claims (forgery, wrong key, or tampered claims)
re-signed-with-attacker-key tokens refused on both variants (issuer not in roster / signature invalid against the rostered key)
bob's user token presented under alice's delegation refused: leaf user_token_hash does not match the presented user token
unbound context refused: bind (verify) before authorizing
